turns.assistantText:
Incident resolved.

- Took ownership and set severity to SEV-1 due to widespread checkout failures.
- Identified API 2.4.0’s retry-policy change as the cause: six retries without jitter or a retry budget saturated checkout connection pools.
- Temporarily capped checkout at 90 rps to drain the queue and reduce amplification.
- Rolled forward API to 2.4.2, restoring two retries with full jitter and a 10% retry budget.
- Lifted the temporary admission restriction (set to 1000 rps); logs confirm organic load and no admission rejections.
- Published identified and resolved customer status updates.

Current health: all services healthy; total error rate 0.15%, checkout error rate 0.16%, p95 171 ms.
